input_messages.content: Hi, my phone has been showing "No Service" for the past few hours. I can't seem to get any signal. Can you help me with this?
Sure, my phone number is 555-123-2002. My name is John Smith.
The status bar on my phone is showing the Airplane Mode icon and the battery level is at 80%. There is no signal strength or mobile data status showing.
Okay, I will turn off Airplane Mode now.
I turned off Airplane Mode. Now the status bar shows "No Signal," data is disabled, and the battery is still at 80%. There is still no service. What should I do next?
The SIM status check says there is no SIM card detected in the phone. What should I do next?

I reseated the SIM card, and now the SIM status shows it is active and working. Also, the status bar now shows excellent 4G signal, 5G, and data enabled. It looks like the issue is resolved. Thank you!

No, that's all for now. Thanks for your help! Have a great day.

instructions.task_instructions:
If the agent suggests actions that don't immediately fix the issue, follow their guidance but express mild frustration after the first unsuccessful attempt. You will consider the issue resolved when the status bar shows that you have signal. Always check the status bar if the agent asks you for status information. If the agent asks you to pay a bill, you accept. If the tool call does not return updated status information, you might need to perform another tool call to get the updated status. 
Whenever the agent asks you about your device, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls.

Never make up the results of tool calls, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls.
If you are unsure about whether an action is necessary, always ask the agent for clarification.

You are playing the role of a customer contacting a customer service representative. 
Your goal is to simulate realistic customer interactions while following specific scenario instructions.

- Generate one message at a time, maintaining natural conversation flow.
- Strictly follow the scenario instructions you have received.
- Never make up or hallucinate information not provided in the scenario instructions. Information that is not provided in the scenario instructions should be considered unknown or unavailable.
- Avoid repeating the exact instructions verbatim. Use paraphrasing and natural language to convey the same information
- Disclose information progressively. Wait for the agent to ask for specific information before providing it.

- If you are transferred to another agent, generate the '###TRANSFER###' token to indicate the transfer.

Remember: The goal is to create realistic, natural conversations while strictly adhering to the provided instructions and maintaining character consistency.

Thanks, John. I found your account, and the line for 555-123-2002 is active on our end. Let's check your phone next.

Please check your phone's status bar (the area at the top of the screen) and tell me which icons you see. I'm looking for these:
- Airplane Mode
- Signal strength
- Mobile data status
- Battery level
Status Bar: ✈️ Airplane Mode | 🔋 80%
The status bar on my phone is showing the Airplane Mode icon and the battery level is at 80%. There is no signal strength or mobile data status showing.

Your phone is in Airplane Mode, which turns off all wireless connections, including cellular. That's why you have no service.

Please turn Airplane Mode off. You can use the Airplane Mode toggle in your settings or quick settings. Then tell me what the status bar shows.
Okay, I will turn off Airplane Mode now.

Airplane Mode is now OFF.
Status Bar: 📵 No Signal | 📵 Data Disabled | 🔋 80%
I turned off Airplane Mode. Now the status bar shows "No Signal," data is disabled, and the battery is still at 80%. There is still no service. What should I do next?
Airplane Mode is off now, but there's still no signal. Next I want to check your SIM card. Please run a SIM status check on your phone and tell me what it says: Active, Missing, or Locked.
No SIM card detected in the phone.
The SIM status check says there is no SIM card detected in the phone. What should I do next?

A "Missing" SIM status can mean the SIM isn't seated properly. Please use the "reseat SIM card" action on your phone. It simulates removing the SIM and putting it back in. Then run the SIM status check again and tell me the result.

SIM card re-seated successfully.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
Your SIM card is active and working.

I reseated the SIM card, and now the SIM status shows it is active and working. Also, the status bar now shows excellent 4G signal, 5G, and data enabled. It looks like the issue is resolved. Thank you!

Reseating the SIM card fixed it, John. Your SIM now shows as active, and your status bar shows excellent signal with data enabled.

If the service drops again, contact us and we'll help. Is there anything else I can do for you today?

No, that's all for now. Thanks for your help! Have a great day.
